documents.text: II . The unit did not complete its training before the end of the war and was disbanded eight months after formation . Squadron history [ edit ] No . 94 Squadron was formed at Castlereagh , New South Wales , on 30 May 1945 . It was planned to equip the squadron with de Havilland Mosquito aircraft and assign it to No . 86 Wing . Its personnel were housed at RAAF Base Richmond until 29 June when they moved to Castlereagh .
